score_features.plan_days: number of days in plan, compared with expected plan length
score_features.quality_days: count of hard days or quality session types
score_features.hard_day_indices: indices of hard days used for spacing checks
score_features.rest_day_indices: indices of rest days used for rest structure checks
score_features.fixture_adjusted_total_range: expected weekly load range conditioned on athlete band, readiness, recovery capability, and race phase
score_features.expected_hard_range: expected hard-day range conditioned on athlete band, readiness, recovery capability, and race phase
score_features.expected_rest_range: expected rest-day range conditioned on readiness and recovery capability
